rows.en:
You can't mean…!?

That Number Ten existed long, long before the Earth did…?

And that when we discovered and recognized Number Ten, it grew alarmed and launched a surprise attack… Is that what you're saying?

I understand how you feel…

But… what I'm trying to say is that there is no true enemy!

And if there is one, I'm saying it would be we humans ourselves!

After all, Steel Emperor Zephas is neither an alien nor a kaiju… he's unmistakably a human of Earth, isn't he?
So… what about [HERO4]? What happened to Takeshi and the others?

…!?

Pull yourself together, [HERO2]! I know it's a shock! But if you don't get a grip…
Oyassan! Please don't blame [HERO2].

Hongo and the others stormed into the space fortress!

Before Atefarina died… no, before she became like that, she lifted the Dimensional Distortion Field barrier for us.

I see…

But what does it mean, that [HERO4] fused with an EATER? What on earth happened?
Rather than fusing… it was really more like cannibalism…

There wasn't even time to help…

It all happened in an instant… Even we can hardly bear to think that thing was [HERO4]…

That bad…?

So where did she go? [HERO4]?
We don't know…

We can't even tell whether that was really…

[HERO4]? Or maybe it was Atefarina…

So Atefarina had made herself a test subject too?

She was living in symbiosis with Vol cells, and holding them in check with Fusion Steel so she wouldn't lose herself…
Then she lost her fight with us… and her Fusion Steel stopped working! And so it awakened…

Takeshi…!?

…Oh, it's not you!

W-welcome…
Kaori…?
It's been a while, [HERO2]…
You… How dare you show your face here! What do you want!?

Wait!

I need help! Your help…
Help…?

At first, Dr. Hinata thought it was a single-celled organism with the ability to move… a kind of slime mold.

But no matter where he looked, he couldn't find a cell nucleus… So he revised his thinking and announced that Vol cells were a type of prokaryotic cell.

However, there was just one thing the doctor simply couldn't explain…

As you know, a cell has three functional parts: the cell surface, the cytoplasm and the nucleus.

The surface protects the cell from its environment, passes information gained from it to the cytoplasm, and also handles movement…

The cytoplasm functions as a production unit, making the compounds needed based on that information.

And the nucleus is what controls all of it.

But when Vol cells, which should be a type of prokaryotic cell with no nucleus, fuse with a higher animal such as a human…

the nucleus of that eukaryotic cell stops responding entirely.

Yes…

Closer to home, the Gigants we've been fighting are a prime example…

Not necessarily…

But what's certain is that they were almost surely higher animals with eukaryotic cells.
No… I can hardly believe it. That such a creature existed on this Earth…

That's the problem…

To call it a creature of Earth…

No, it would be simpler to call it an extraterrestrial life form.
The case where bacteria and other microorganisms clinging to the hull of the escape pod we rescued and recovered were brought to Earth?

Unfortunately…

the power of our science… no, the power of mankind itself, is truly helpless in this vast universe.
Satoru…
[HERO4] is…

I know…

Because the same change is happening to us too…
The same change?
That's right…
Just like Atefarina devoured Satoru's sister, the change is starting to show up in us too.
Satoru, what do you mean?
We've been staying alive by devouring these Gigants as the nearest food at hand!
Devouring Gigants?
Tell me… Why? Why is your EATER… no, why are you all right?

I see…

Come to think of it… for some reason, both [HERO4] and I seem to be suppressing nuclear division…?
Back then… what did Atefarina do to you two?
Back then…?
That day we were burned out of the laboratory… Atefarina must have done something to you two for some experiment.
We may be test subjects alike… but our purposes are different! Ours and yours…!
That's what I want to know…
Even if you ask me that… I have no idea either…?

Don't lie!

As a fellow EATER, you should need to devour other EATERs too!
Please! Tell us! [HERO2]!! We don't have much time left…!
It's no use! It'd be faster to ask his body directly!
Stop it! Tatsuya!!
Gwoooooooh!!
Tatsuyaaa!! Hang in there, Tatsuya!!

Kuh… Don't worry! Our Vol won't die…

But… my body as Tatsuya Todo… is done for…
That's not true! You'll be all right! Tatsuya…

Heh heh heh… The Vol inside me is saying so… that this one's done for…

Once the Vol cells abandon you… there's no hope left! Give up… Kaori…

No! You can't give up!

To overcome Vol, you have to awaken to your own self… and gain an unbreakable strength of will! That's what Papa said…

That's right…

Your old man… was Dr. Hinata's assistant, wasn't he… I think I remember hearing that…

That's right… This [HERO2] is the proof!

He keeps his sanity without being controlled by Vol! Vol isn't perfect! Tatsuya! Please… live…

Heh heh, too bad…

There's one crucial way I'm different from [HERO2]… ugh…
Different… how?
That's right…
Tatsuya…
Tatsuya…

Ugh… Unlike you… I have…

I have nothing to protect… and no one I love… I have nothing to lose…
Tatsuya…

Having no one to lean on… that's what makes me… so fragile!

Fight, [HERO2]… Protect [HERO4]…
Tatsuya…!
Tatsuya…!
Tatsuyaaa!!
Move…

…!?

Satoru…!?

…!?

Satoru…!?
Out of the way… I'm going to devour Tatsuya!
What!?
Uoooooh…
Well? Still no word from the assault team?
Nothing so far…

No, I doubt that's the case…

Besides, it would be a problem if the space fortress exploded right now…

We're still preparing to spread a lead barrier over the whole area, applying Project Blue, in case of secondary disasters after the explosion…
Hmm… Will it be ready in time?

uncertain: U15786: Atefarina 'she'; 'before she became like that' refers to her fusing with [HERO4].
U15790/U15792: [HERO4] referred to as 'she'; whether the fused being is [HERO4] or Atefarina is left open, as in the source.
U15797: narration row without speaker; reads as [HERO2] recognizing Kaori. U15796 is absent from the batch.
U15799: [HERO2]'s hostility to Kaori kept at full strength.
U15815: Satoru's sister = [HERO4] (Satoru Hinata); 'devoured' kept literal.
U15820: 核分裂 rendered 'nuclear division' (cell nucleus), consistent with B0173/B0174.
U15838/U15844/U15849/U15853/U15856: Vortex speaker variants of [HERO2] lines.
U15860: Dr. Iwamoto's 'No, I doubt that's the case' answers Takenaka's 'Nothing so far'; meaning slightly unclear.
